Executed directly by bubbles.goal (parent-expanded). The test phase surfaced a REAL regression in SCN-009-006/007/008: expected quote.status 'stale', received 'available'. Root-caused with measured numbers rather than patched: the production threshold at msft-july-print-model.html:1527 is quote-relative (evaluationAtMs - retrievedAtMs > 86400000, i.e. 24h vs the QUOTE's retrievedAt), but the test derived the quote's evaluation time from the BARS envelope (barsEnvelope.fetched + 25h). data/options/MSFT.json refreshes on every brief run (4x/day) while data/bars/MSFT.json refreshes only after-hours, so on the current tree they are 18.00h apart: quote.fetched 2026-07-30T14:30:13.574Z vs bars.fetched 2026-07-29T20:30:14.156Z. The derived evaluation time therefore sat only 7.00h past the quote's own retrievedAt - inside the 24h window - so 'available' was the TRUTHFUL model output and calling it 'stale' would have been the actual bug. THE MODEL WAS CORRECT; THE TEST WAS WRONG. Fixed the test to derive from quoteEnvelope.fetched. Mutation-proved the assertion is live, not dodged: widening the production threshold to 999999999999 makes the test FAIL (exit 1, 1 failed / 5 passed), and the model file was restored byte-clean (git diff --stat = 0 lines).
